function.name: VarDateFromR4
function.signature: HRESULT WINAPI VarDateFromR4(FLOAT fltIn, DATE* pdateOut)
function.header_comment:
/******************************************************************************
 * VarDateFromR4 (OLEAUT32.91)
 *
 * Convert a VT_R4 to a VT_DATE.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  fltIn    [I] Source
 *  pdateOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
